definitions.explanation: The act of stealing merchandise from a retail store. Also refers to the person who shoplifts.

examples.japanese: {万引|まんび}きは{犯罪|はんざい}です。
{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラで{万引|まんび}きの{瞬間|しゅんかん}が{撮影|さつえい}された。
examples.english: The moment of shoplifting was captured on a security camera.

examples.japanese: {万引|まんび}きによる{被害額|ひがいがく}は{年間|ねんかん}{数百億円|すうひゃくおくえん}に{上|のぼ}ると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It is said that losses from shoplifting amount to tens of billions of yen annually.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used as a suru-verb: {万引|まんび}きする (to shoplift). Can also refer to the person who shoplifts ({万引|まんび}き{犯|はん} is more specific). Store signs often use the phrase {万引|まんび}きは{犯罪|はんざい}です (shoplifting is a crime).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {万引|まんび}きする (to shoplift)
- {万引|まんび}き{犯|はん} (shoplifter)
- {万引|まんび}き{防止|ぼうし} (shoplifting prevention)
- {万引|まんび}きで{捕|つか}まる (to be caught shoplifting)
